paragraphs: The 535i was a mainstay of the F10/F11 5 Series generation from 2010 to 2017, powered by the N55 — a 3.0-litre straight-six turbocharged petrol engine that was broadly well-regarded for its performance and reliability. The N55 replaced the earlier twin-turbo N54 and brought a single twin-scroll turbocharger setup, Valvetronic variable valve lift, and direct fuel injection. The 535i sat as the mid-range six-cylinder petrol option, above the four-cylinder 520i and 528i, and below the V8-powered 550i. The F10/F11 535i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: The F10/F11 535i uses the N55 engine exclusively throughout its 2010–2017 production run. However, different 535i models can have different specifications — the engine's ancillaries, ECU software and even some internal components can vary between model years and option packages.
